headline.zh:
给读不到源码的 coding agent
埋下诱饵，一触即警
headline.en:
Plant a decoy in a closed
coding agent — catch the probe

sub.zh: 诱饵主机名和假凭证一旦被解析或连接，立刻红色告警并留下签名审计证据——把「它有没有偷偷外联」从一次次反编译，变成一个可核验的事件。
sub.en: The instant a planted decoy hostname or fake credential is resolved or connected, you get an alarm plus signed audit evidence — turning 'did it exfiltrate?' from a decompilation project into a checkable event.

title.en: Plant a decoy, it trips on touch

body.zh: 生成一个看起来像真内部资产的主机名和假凭证，丢进 agent 能读到的地方。一旦它去解析或连接这个诱饵，终端立刻弹出红色告警，写下一行审计记录。
body.en: Mint a hostname and a fake credential that look like real internal assets, drop them where the agent can read them. The moment it resolves or connects one, the terminal flashes a red alarm and writes an audit line.

body.zh: 每次触发都写进不可篡改的审计日志，并能产出一份签名证据报告——干净或触发，一目了然。一条命令重新校验签名，确认证据没被改过。
body.en: Every trip lands in a tamper-evident audit log and can render a signed evidence report — clean or tripped, at a glance. One command re-verifies the signature to confirm the evidence was not edited.

body.zh: 传感器只绑在本机回环地址上，诱饵解析也指向回环——探测不会真的把流量送出去。单机部署，无需联网，适合信创与等保的内网边界。
body.en: Sensors bind only to the loopback address and decoys resolve to it too — a probe never actually sends traffic off the box. Single-host, no network needed, fit for air-gapped boundaries.

title.en: Evidence you can trust, a trap that won't go blind

body.zh: 签报告的那把密钥，从生成那一刻起就不对同机其他租户可读——没人能趁它落地的间隙偷走、事后伪造一份「干净」结论。你给诱饵配置随手加个注释，该响的时候照样响；即便审计日志或诱饵清单被改坏、被截断，报告也会把缺口标出来，而不是悄悄读成「干净」或直接崩掉——一次真实的触发，绝不会变成一行看不见的静默。
body.en: The key that signs your report is never readable to a co-tenant on the box from the moment it's created — no one can swipe it in that landing window and later forge a 'clean' verdict. A stray comment in your decoy config can't blind the trap; and if the audit log or the decoy manifest is corrupted or truncated, the report surfaces the gap instead of silently reading 'clean' or crashing — a real trip can never become an invisible silent miss.

chips: › key that signs the report, never briefly readable
› a stray config comment can't blind the trap
› a corrupted trail can't hide a trip
› a tampered manifest can't crash your evidence

headline.zh: 想知道它有没有偷偷外联？埋个诱饵就知道。
headline.en: Want to know if it exfiltrates? Plant a decoy.

sub.zh: 把「它碰了不该碰的东西吗」变成一个能拍下的瞬间。
sub.en: Turn 'did it touch what it shouldn't?' into a screenshotable moment.
